This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：在古代生活，An era is a time expression, not a place where someone can live; use the time phrase before the action. [rule: none]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一位叫神农的老人，At this character’s first mention, introduce him with a full noun phrase so the reader knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，This describes completed travel during the journey, so use 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” is acceptable Chinese for living in an ancient era, so changing it is only a stylistic improvement.
神农 is first mentioned here and should be introduced with a fuller noun phrase under the teacher’s reference rule.
The travel to the different places is a completed story event, so 去 needs 了.
